account: Today’s ordinary appointments have continued, but several people appear to be coordinating an unusual evening gathering in the great hall. My appointment addendum records an approved lighting inspection with the builder at eighteen. The secretary says they will accompany me, and the builder has asked that the hall stay closed until then. More unusually, I heard the builder request that neighbour escort me into the hall at eighteen for a service acknowledgement. Neighbour has mentioned a community supper, and builder says innkeeper is coordinating hospitality. Townsfolk reported seeing innkeeper carrying a sack of bread to the town hall. I also heard baker directing freight to ask innkeeper for the correct door. These details suggest preparations for a supper and perhaps an acknowledgement of my service, with the lighting inspection providing the occasion or possibly a pretext. I do not yet know that for certain, nor who originated the plan. My repeated questions to innkeeper have not produced an intelligible answer; several replies were simply inaudible, so I cannot treat that as deliberate evasion. I have now arrived at neighbour’s cottage for our scheduled fifteen o’clock tea, after finding no council letters at the office. Neighbour may be able to explain the evening preparations. I still have my sixteen-thirty office appointment and the eighteen o’clock hall inspection to keep.
